# DCYFR

> The unified portal for the DCYFR product ecosystem — templates, research, agent tools, and infrastructure solutions built for AI-powered development.

## Pages
- [Home](https://dcyfr.io/): Portal homepage — the DCYFR product catalog grouped by tier, unified search, and latest research from the DCYFR blog.

## Related sites
- [DCYFR Templates](https://dcyfr.app/): Next.js starter templates.
- [DCYFR Research](https://dcyfr.tech/): Research and engineering blog.
- [DCYFR Codes](https://dcyfr.codes/): Code resources.
